title: Kissed Crisp Greek Tomatoes Horiatiki Salad
description: A classic Greek salad with a twist, featuring smoky olive oil and crisp tomatoes, perfect for a comforting meal. This diabetic-friendly dish is made with fresh ingredients and a hint of wine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the tomatoes in half and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the smoky olive oil over the tomatoes and season with salt.
Roast the tomatoes in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly caramelized.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced red onion, cucumber, and Kalamata olives.
Once the tomatoes are ready, let them cool slightly and then add them to the bowl.
Crumble the feta cheese over the top of the salad and sprinkle with chopped fresh oregano.
In a small bowl, whisk together the red wine vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve the salad immediately, garnished with additional oregano if desired.
